verdict.rationale: Letta supports fully self-hosted deployment where 'agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control' and local mode 'does not require a Letta login,' implying user data need not leave their own infrastructure — but there is no explicit statement about a training-data opt-out or policy on whether cloud-hosted usage (chat.letta.com, Letta Cloud) is used to train models. Missing for 10: an explicit data-training/privacy policy statement, an opt-out toggle, or terms-of-service language addressing model training use of user data.
